description: This Java class implements a service for service discovery using Zookeeper. It manages Zookeeper client initialization, node registration, event handling for other service nodes, and partition recalculations within a distributed system.

classes.name: ZkDiscoveryService
classes.description: Service class for managing Zookeeper-based service discovery, node registration, event handling, and partition recalculations.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the discovery service, asserts required properties, and sets up Zookeeper client.

methods.name: getOtherServers
methods.description: Returns a list of other service instances discovered via Zookeeper.

methods.name: isMonolith
methods.description: Indicates whether the service runs as a monolith; always returns false.

methods.name: onApplicationEvent
methods.description: Handles application startup event to start service registration and partition recalculation.

methods.name: publishCurrentServer
methods.description: Creates or updates the Zookeeper node representing the current service instance.

methods.name: setReady
methods.description: Marks the current service as ready or not, updating Zookeeper data accordingly.

methods.name: currentServerExists
methods.description: Checks if the current service node exists in Zookeeper and matches current service info.

methods.name: checkReconnect
methods.description: Returns a listener to handle Zookeeper connection state changes, triggering reconnection if lost.

methods.name: reconnect
methods.description: Reconnects to Zookeeper, reinitializing client and re-registering service node.

methods.name: initZkClient
methods.description: Initializes and starts the Zookeeper client and cache.

methods.name: subscribeToEvents
methods.description: Subscribes the service to Zookeeper node events.

methods.name: unpublishCurrentServer
methods.description: Deletes the current service node from Zookeeper.

methods.name: destroyZkClient
methods.description: Stops and cleans up the Zookeeper client and cache.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Shutdown hook to clean up resources on service shutdown.

methods.name: childEvent
methods.description: Handles Zookeeper node events such as child added or removed, triggering partition recalculations or events.

methods.name: recalculatePartitions
methods.description: Recalculates service partitions based on current known service nodes.
